So they all made boats and __37__ except (除了) Love. Love was the only one who stayed. When the island had almost disappeared into the water, Love decided to __38__ for help.
Richness in a big boat was passing by Love. Love asked, "Richness, can you __39__ me with you?" Richness answered, "No, I can't. There is no __40__ here for you."
Love decided to ask Sadness. "Sadness, please help me!" "I can't help you, Love. I am so __41__ that I need to be by myself!" Sadness answered.
Happiness passed by Love, too, but she was so happy that she did not hear when Love called her.
Suddenly, there was a __42__, "Come, Love. I will take you." It was an old man. Love was happy and __43__ forgot to ask where they were going. When they arrived at a __44__ place, the man walked away. Love asked Knowledge, "Who helped me?"

As home to 45 ethnic minorities (少数民族), Yunnan offers unusual and exciting experiences of ethnic customs.
Here are the top 3 festival tours that are worth attending in 4042.

【The Torch Festival】
It is a traditional festival among the Yi, Naxi, and Bai minority groups. Every family should light a big torch in front of their doors for 3 days. Of the Torch Festival celebrations, the most famous one is the Lijiang Torch Festival.
Date: July/August (days 44 to 46 of the sixth lunar month)
Location: Lijiang
Recommended Tour: 3-Day Ancient Lijiang Tour

【The Water Festival】
It is the most important festival for the Dai people in Yunnan. During the celebration, people throw water at each other to wash away bad things. There are also other joyful celebrations, such as lantern floating to attend.
Date: April 13 to 15
Location: Xishuangbanna
Recommended tour: 6-Day Xishuangbanna and Pu'er Tour

【The Horse Race Festival】
It falls on the same date as the Dragon Boat Festival and usually lasts for 3 days. Tibetans in Yunnan get together to have the celebrations. Traditional horse riding performances and competitions like horse racing will be held.
Date: May/June (5th of the fifth lunar month)
Location: Shangri-La
Recommended tour: 8-Day Tengchong and the Nu River Tour

If you are planning to visit Yunnan, click here to see our Festival Tours, or we are ready to help you create a festival tour according to your requirements (要求).
passages.P_readB:
Reyes Guana, 42, grew up in a poor Mexican family. He has seven brothers and sisters. His parents always had two jobs to make ends meet.
As a boy, Guana had a good relationship (关系) with the school cleaner. He called her "Nike" because she wore Nike shoes. The boy liked how Nike made everything clean. He told her he wanted to be a cleaner, too. "Well, it's good if you want to be a cleaner," Nike told little Guana. "But make sure you go to college."
Guana also looked up to the principal (校长) of his school. The school leader told the boy that his job was to help students and teachers. "Wow, when I grow up I want to do what you're doing." "Well, if you stick to your dream, you will," the principal answered.
And Guana really got there. But it was quite a long journey for him. Twenty-three years ago, he followed in Nike's footsteps and was cleaning schools. He worked at three schools to pay his college education. He held that job for four years
Now, as a leader of a middle school, Guana never forgets where he came from. He helps students from poor families and shows respect for every school staff member. He always invites everyone to school parties, including those who clean the floors and those who drive the school buses.
passages.P_readC:
TOILET, bathroom, restroom — English has many words for the little room we all have to go to every day.
Different countries often use different words.
In the US, you will get where you need to go if you ask where the "bathroom" is. If you're in a shopping mall, you should ask for directions to the "restroom".
People from the US also use the word "John". It comes from the name of a 39th century British man. He invented the flush toilet.
In Britain, people often say "toilet" and "bathroom". You sometimes see the words "Ladies" and "Gentlemen" above the doors to public toilets. But "Men" and "Women" are more common now in Britain. Australians say "loo". The word is also quite popular in the UK. Canadians use the word "can", New Zealanders "bog" and South Africans "want to go to the bathroom". In China, Beijing now uses the word "toilet" rather than "WC". All over the world now signs rather than words are used.
Where does the word toilet itself come from? Well, it's from the French "toilette" — to wash yourself.
passages.P_readD:
Swifts (雨燕) live mostly in the air. These small birds are among the fastest animals on Earth. In fact, swifts can go two or three days without touching the ground! To get used to life in the sky, swifts use their speed and the saliva (唾液) in their mouths.
Swifts can fly faster than 100 miles per hour. That's because their wings are like boomerangs (飞行器). This shape of the wings helps them to fly much faster. They can also move one wing faster than the other, which allows them to make sharp turns without slowing down. Making fast, sharp turns helps swifts catching flying bugs to eat.
The saliva helps swifts catch bugs to feed their young. It is sticky, like glue. Swifts often fly into clouds of bugs such as mosquitoes and open their wide mouths to catch as many insects as they can. The bird collects insects in its mouth gradually and holds the insects in a sticky ball of saliva. One food ball can contain nearly 1,000 bugs.
Swifts also use their saliva as glue to build their nests. The birds catch feathers in the air and stick the feathers together to build a strong nest on the side of a building. Swifts' short feet are not good for walking or standing on land for long. But their sharp claws allow them to stick to rocks and walls so they can take a brief rest before returning their lives in the sky.

questions.stem:
22. —Jack, you learn physics so well. What's your ____?
—Doing a lot of exercises.
questions.analysis: 问句问的是“你物理学习这么好，秘诀是什么？”，secret 表示“秘诀”，ability 表示“能力”，hobby 表示“爱好”，所以选 B。

questions.stem: 23. ____ you need help, I will always stand by you.
questions.analysis: 句意为“无论何时你需要帮助，我都会一直在你身边支持你”，whenever 表示“无论何时”，whatever 表“无论什么”，whoever 表“无论谁”，所以选 C。

questions.stem:
24. —Would you please ____ your email address? I missed it just now.
—No problem. It's fox@363.com.
questions.analysis: 由后半句“I missed it just now（我刚才没听清）”可知，是请对方“重复（repeat）”一遍邮箱地址；review 意为“复习/回顾”，report 意为“报道”，所以选 A。

questions.stem:
25. —Mr. Black, could you tell me ____ our Chinese exam?
—Sure. It will be in Room 101.
questions.tag: 宾语从句语序与引导词
questions.analysis: 答语“It will be in Room 101.”回答的是地点，所以用 where 引导宾语从句；宾语从句要用陈述句语序（主语在前、助动词在后），即 where we will have，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 26. Could you please ____ TV? I'm studying for my test.
questions.tag: 情态动词委婉请求句型
questions.analysis: “Could you please (not) do sth.?”表示礼貌请求，后接动词原形，否定形式直接在动词原形前加 not，所以选 A。

questions.stem: 27. I must go abroad for an international meeting. Could you help me ____ the earliest flight online?
questions.analysis: 句意为“你能帮我在网上查一下最早的航班吗？”。look up 表示“查阅（信息/资料）”，look out 表示“小心”，look through 表示“浏览”，所以选 C。

questions.stem:
28. —Who's your ____ to practice conversations in English class?
—Paul, my deskmate.
questions.analysis: 在英语课上一起练习对话的是“搭档、同伴（partner）”；patient 意为“病人”，parent 意为“父/母”，所以选 A。

questions.stem:
29. —All of my classmates have passed the English test.
—____ exciting the news is!
questions.analysis: 感叹句中心词是形容词 exciting，结构为“How + 形容词 + 主语 + 谓语！”，所以选 A。

questions.stem:
30. —Miss Li, happy Teachers' Day! Here is a flower for you.
—Wow! Thanks for your ____.
questions.analysis: 学生祝教师节快乐并送上一朵花，老师表示感谢这份“礼物（present）”，所以选 A。

questions.stem:
31. —The Internet has made communication much more ____.
—I agree. For example, I can communicate with my friends on WeChat any time.
questions.analysis: 由下句“可以随时在微信上和朋友交流”可知，互联网让沟通变得更加“方便（convenient）”，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 32. The waiters of the restaurant treat people ____. They always serve them with big smiles on their faces.
questions.analysis: 由“总是面带大大的微笑服务”可知，服务员“礼貌地（politely）”对待顾客，所以选 C。

questions.stem:
33. —I am wondering ____ you'd like to come to my party tomorrow.
—I'm afraid I can't because I'm not feeling well these days.
questions.analysis: 句意为“我想知道你明天是否愿意来参加我的派对”，wonder 后接表示“是否”的宾语从句用 whether，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 34. The girl ____ on the grassland and counted the stars.
questions.analysis: 句意为“女孩躺在草地上数星星”，and 后 counted 为过去式，所以前面用“躺（lie）”的过去式 lay；lied 是“撒谎”，laid 是“放置/下蛋”，所以选 A。

questions.stem:
35. —What is the best way to see the beautiful countryside?
—____. When I don't need to rush, I'd like to see it by bike.
questions.analysis: 回答“要看情况而定（It depends）”，后面补充“不赶时间的时候我喜欢骑车看”，符合语境，所以选 C。

questions.stem: One day the __36__ were told that the island would sink (下沉).
questions.analysis: 前一句提到“many feelings lived on an island”，所以这里指这些“情感（feelings）”被告知小岛要下沉，选 A。

questions.stem: So they all made boats and __37__ except (除了) Love.
questions.analysis: 后句说“Love was the only one who stayed（爱是唯一留下来的）”，说明其他情感造好船后都“离开（left）”了，选 B。

questions.stem: When the island had almost disappeared into the water, Love decided to __38__ for help.
questions.analysis: ask for help 是固定短语，意为“寻求帮助”，且下文紧接着写 Love 向 Richness、Sadness 求助，选 A。

questions.stem: Love asked, "Richness, can you __39__ me with you?"
questions.analysis: take sb. with sb. 表示“把某人带在身边/顺便带上某人”，符合 Love 请求富贵坐船带她一起走的语境，选 C。

questions.stem: Richness answered, "No, I can't. There is no __40__ here for you."
questions.analysis: room 在这里作不可数名词，意为“空间、余地”，表示船上没有地方容纳 Love 了，选 B。

questions.stem: "I can't help you, Love. I am so __41__ that I need to be by myself!" Sadness answered.
questions.analysis: 说话者是 Sadness（悲伤），她回答说自己太“伤心（sad）”了，需要一个人待着，选 C。

questions.stem: Suddenly, there was a __42__, "Come, Love. I will take you."
questions.analysis: 后面紧接直接引语“Come, Love. I will take you.”，可知是突然传来一个“声音（voice）”，选 A。

questions.stem: Love was happy and __43__ forgot to ask where they were going.
questions.analysis: Love 获救后非常高兴，“甚至（even）”忘了问他们要去哪里，选 B。

questions.stem: When they arrived at a __44__ place, the man walked away.
questions.analysis: 前面小岛即将沉没，老人用船把 Love 带到一个“安全的（safe）”地方后才离开，选 C。

questions.stem: Knowledge smiled and answered, "Because only Time can understand __45__ valuable (有价值的) Love is."
questions.tag: 完形填空·宾语从句感叹词
questions.analysis: 空后直接修饰形容词 valuable，表示“多么有价值”，修饰形容词要用 how，选 A。

questions.stem: 46. This passage is mainly about ____.
questions.analysis: 文章开头点明主题“Here are the top 3 festival tours that are worth attending”，每个节日后都配有 Recommended Tour，文末也是推荐 Festival Tours，因此选 B。

questions.stem: 47. If you want to know more about the custom of the Naxi minority, ____ may be your best choice.
options: D. 8-Day Tengchong and the Nu River Tour
questions.analysis: 文中提到火把节是彝族、纳西族（Naxi）和白族的传统节日，其对应的推荐路线是“3-Day Ancient Lijiang Tour”，所以选 A。

questions.stem: 48. During the Water Festival, you can attend wonderful celebrations like ____.
questions.analysis: 在 The Water Festival 部分明确写到“There are also other joyful celebrations, such as lantern floating to attend.”，所以选 B。

questions.stem: 49. If you are interested in riding horses, you may go to ____ for vacation.
questions.analysis: The Horse Race Festival 有传统骑马表演和赛马活动，其 Location（地点）是 Shangri-La（香格里拉），所以选 C。

questions.stem: 50. Where is the text most probably taken from?
questions.analysis: 文章最后一段出现“click here to see our Festival Tours（点击这里查看节日旅游线路）”，这是网页超链接的典型表达，因此最可能来自网站，选 D。

questions.stem: 51. Guana hoped to be a cleaner because he ____.
options: B. admired the cleaner "Nike" a lot
C. needed to support his poor family
D. had to pay for his college education
questions.answer_display: B. admired the cleaner "Nike" a lot
questions.analysis: 第二段提到小 Guana 和学校保洁员 Nike 关系很好，“The boy liked how Nike made everything clean. He told her he wanted to be a cleaner, too.”，说明他很佩服/喜欢 Nike 才想当保洁员，选 B。

questions.stem: 52. Guana became a school safety monitor ____.
options: B. after he worked as a teacher
C. as soon as he got enough money
D. before he was named principal
questions.answer_display: D. before he was named principal
questions.tag: 阅读理解·时间顺序推理
questions.analysis: 注意本卷第5页末与第6页首之间原文有段落缺失。结合上下文（23年前即19岁起做保洁员4年，现已任中学校长）及人物经历顺序（保洁员→校园安全员→教师→校长），他担任校园安全员是在成为校长之前，选 D。

questions.stem: 53. The underlined phrase "got there" actually means ____.
questions.analysis: 前一段末校长对想当校长的 Guana 说“if you stick to your dream, you will（坚持梦想就会实现）”，紧接着下一段开头说“And Guana really got there.”，因此意思是“实现了他的梦想”，选 C。

questions.stem: 54. According to the writer, ____.
options: A. Guana should have been named principal earlier
B. a boy from a poor family can have a bright future
C. a cleaner is more important than a college student
D. the cleaners and the drivers should get more respect
questions.answer_display: B. a boy from a poor family can have a bright future
questions.analysis: 文章讲述出身贫困家庭的 Guana 通过打工完成大学学业并坚持梦想最终成为中学校长的故事，说明寒门男孩也能拥有光明的未来，选 B。

questions.stem: 55. What would be the best title for this passage?
questions.analysis: 文章完整讲述了 Guana 从当年做学校保洁员（cleaner）一路成长为中学校长（leader of a middle school）的励志经历，“From Cleaner to Leader.”最贴切，选 A。

questions.stem: 56. In the US, people often use "____" for the little room with a toilet.
questions.analysis: 文中第四段明确提到“People from the US also use the word "John".”，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 57. Beijing now often uses the word "____" to refer to "restroom".
questions.analysis: 第五段倒数第二句写到“In China, Beijing now uses the word "toilet" rather than "WC".”，所以选 B。

questions.stem: 58. The underlined word "flush" in Paragraph 4 probably means "____".
questions.analysis: “flush toilet”指抽水马桶，即用水“冲刷（flush）”的马桶，所以选 B。

questions.stem: 59. When referring to toilets, we know that ____.
options: A. the words "Ladies and gentlemen" are impolite
B. the word "toilet" comes from the UK
C. different countries use the same word
D. signs are more often used now
questions.answer_display: D. signs are more often used now
questions.analysis: 第五段最后一句指出“All over the world now signs rather than words are used.（现在世界各地更多使用图标而不是文字）”，所以选 D。

questions.stem: 60. What is the passage about?
options: A. English words for some kinds of rooms.
B. Words for the toilet in different countries.
C. The history of where English words are from.
D. The differences among different Englishes.
questions.answer_display: B. Words for the toilet in different countries.
questions.analysis: 文章开篇点题，介绍了美、英、澳、加、新西兰、南非和中国北京等地对“洗手间/厕所”的不同英文叫法，所以选 B。

questions.stem: 61. The second paragraph mainly talks about ____.
options: A. how fast swifts can fly
B. how swifts turn around in the sky
C. why swifts make sharp turns
D. why swifts can fly and turn so fast
questions.answer_display: D. why swifts can fly and turn so fast
questions.analysis: 第二段解释了雨燕飞行超过每小时100英里的原因（翅膀像飞行器）以及急转弯不减速的原因（一侧翅膀扇动得比另一侧快），所以选 D。

questions.stem: 62. What does the underlined word "it" refer to in paragraph 3?
questions.analysis: 第三段前两句为“The saliva helps swifts catch bugs to feed their young. It is sticky, like glue.”，因此“It”指代前一句的主语“the saliva（唾液）”，选 A。

questions.stem: 63. Which of the following is TRUE about swifts?
options: A. Swifts don't usually live on land because of their wings.
B. Swifts can fly for a long time because of their small bodies.
C. Swifts can't walk for a long time because of their short feet.
D. Swifts can catch nearly 1,000 bugs in one go with the saliva.
questions.answer_display: C. Swifts can't walk for a long time because of their short feet.
questions.analysis: 第四段提到“Swifts' short feet are not good for walking or standing on land for long.”，与 C 项一致；D 项原文说是“gradually（逐渐收集）”而非“in one go（一口气）”，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 64. Which of the following is the best title for the passage?
questions.analysis: 文章第一段引入“live mostly in the air / life in the sky”，下文围绕飞行速度和唾液如何帮助雨燕适应空中生活展开，“Life in the Sky”最能概括全文，选 A。

questions.stem: 65. Which of the following best show the structure of the passage?
questions.analysis: 第①段总起说明雨燕靠“speed（速度）”和“saliva（唾液）”适应空中生活；第②段专门讲速度，第③、④两段均围绕唾液（捕虫、筑巢）展开，因此呈“①→②和(③④)”结构，选 C。

questions.stem: __66__ It doesn't mean that you must always like the subject. It does mean, however, that you must be willing to learn whatever is necessary.
options: B. These ways may help you with your study.
C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.answer_display: E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.analysis: 空后提到“这并不意味着你必须一直喜欢这门学科，但意味着你必须愿意学习必要的内容”，与 E 项“要记住的第一件事是你必须愿意学习”完美衔接，选 E。

questions.stem: Try to understand why it is important and how it will help you now and later and learn other things. __67__ Knowing how to spell makes any kind of writing easier.
options: B. These ways may help you with your study.
C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.answer_display: C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
questions.analysis: 前句说“理解学科为何重要及学会其他知识”，后句举例“学会拼写让写作更容易”，C 项“掌握数学知识将一生受用”与后句并列举例，选 C。

questions.stem: Make good use of your class time to listen to everything the teachers say. __68__
options: B. These ways may help you with your study.
C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.answer_display: D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
questions.analysis: 前句强调“充分利用课堂时间听老师讲课”，D 项“课堂上认真听讲意味着课后作业更少”顺承说明认真听课的好处，选 D。

questions.stem: __69__ Those points were mentioned by the teachers in class will consolidate (巩固) what you have learned.
options: B. These ways may help you with your study.
C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.analysis: 空后出现“Those points（那些要点）”，回指 A 项中的“the important points（重要知识点）”，即复习要点能巩固所学，选 A。

questions.stem: __70__ You will probably discover many others after you have tried these.
options: B. These ways may help you with your study.
C. Knowing math facts will be useful in your whole life.
D. Listening carefully in class means less work after class.
E. The first thing to remember is that you must be willing to learn.
questions.answer_display: B. These ways may help you with your study.
questions.analysis: 空后出现“after you have tried these（尝试了这些方法之后）”，B 项“These ways may help you with your study.”中的 These ways 正好与后文呼应并总结上文方法，选 B。

questions.stem:
71. 考试临近，你想知道该如何复习迎考，会这么问老师：
____?
reference_answer: How should I review for the exam
How can I review for the exam
Could you tell me how I should review for the exam
Could you tell me how to review for the exam
questions.answer_display: How should I review for the exam?
questions.tag: 情景交际·询问学习/复习方法
questions.analysis: 向老师询问“该如何复习迎考”，可用特殊疑问句“How should/can I review for the exam?”，注意句末已印有问号。

questions.stem:
72. 路人问你如何去邮局，你也不太确定，可以这样回答：
____.
reference_answer: Sorry, I'm not sure how to get to the post office.
Sorry, I don't know how to get to the post office.
I'm sorry, I'm not sure where the post office is.
Sorry, I'm not sure how I can get to the post office.
questions.answer_display: Sorry, I'm not sure how to get to the post office.
questions.tag: 情景交际·礼貌回应问路（不确定）
questions.analysis: 对问路表示不太确定时，先礼貌致歉（Sorry / I'm sorry），再用“I'm not sure how to get to the post office.”表达不清楚怎么去邮局。

questions.stem:
73. 中秋节赏月的时候，你看到月亮非常明亮，你会这么感慨：
____!
reference_answer: How bright the moon is!
What a bright moon!
How bright the moon is
What a bright moon
questions.analysis: 感叹月亮非常明亮，可用 How 引导感叹句“How bright the moon is!”，也可用 What 引导“What a bright moon!”。

questions.stem:
74. 你想知道哪里可以买到杂志，会有礼貌地询问路人道：
Excuse me, ____?
reference_answer: could you please tell me where I can buy magazines
could you tell me where I can buy some magazines
could you please tell me where I can buy a magazine
do you know where I can buy magazines
questions.answer_display: could you please tell me where I can buy magazines
questions.tag: 情景交际·礼貌问路与宾语从句
questions.analysis: 礼貌询问信息常用“Excuse me, could you (please) tell me where I can buy magazines?”，注意宾语从句要用陈述句语序，且句首 Excuse me 与句末问号已给出。

questions.stem:
75. 在国庆节期间，你吃了好多美食，长胖了2磅，你会这么跟朋友说：
I enjoyed the food I ate during National Day. But it's sad that ____.
reference_answer: I put on two pounds
I have put on two pounds
I've put on two pounds
I put on 2 pounds
I have put on 2 pounds
questions.tag: 情景交际·动词短语 put on
questions.analysis: “长胖/增加体重”用固定短语 put on (weight)，长胖了2磅表达为“I put on two pounds”或现在完成时“I have put on two pounds”。

questions.stem: 76. 看图写句（图：月饼；提示词：shape）
reference_answer: Mooncakes are in the shape of a full moon.
The mooncake is in the shape of a full moon.
questions.answer_display: Mooncakes are in the shape of a full moon.
questions.tag: 看图写话·介词短语 in the shape of
questions.analysis: 图中是圆形的月饼，结合课文常用短语 in the shape of...（呈……的形状），可写“Mooncakes are in the shape of a full moon.”。

questions.stem: 77. 看图写句（图：Bookstore 与 School 相对/相邻；提示词：there be）
reference_answer: There is a bookstore across from the school.
There is a bookstore near the school.
There is a bookstore next to the school.
There is a bookstore behind the school.
questions.answer_display: There is a bookstore across from the school.
questions.tag: 看图写话·there be 句型与方位介词
questions.analysis: 图中有书店（Bookstore）和学校（School），使用 there be 句型加上方位介词（如 across from / near / behind），可写“There is a bookstore across from the school.”。

questions.stem: 78. 看图写句（图：城市中的穹顶建筑/博物馆或宫殿；提示词：wonder; if）
reference_answer: I wonder if we can visit the museum.
I wonder if the museum is open today.
I wonder if there is a museum near here.
questions.answer_display: I wonder if we can visit the museum.
questions.tag: 看图写话·if 引导宾语从句
questions.analysis: 用 wonder + if 引导宾语从句，注意从句要用陈述句语序，结合图中建筑物可写“I wonder if we can visit the museum.”（注意原图黑白简笔画建筑具体场所略有歧义）。

questions.stem: 79. 看图写句（图：三名同学围坐圆桌小组学习；提示词：learn; by）
reference_answer: They learn English by working with a group.
They learn by studying with a group.
They learn English by discussing with friends.
questions.answer_display: They learn English by working with a group.
questions.tag: 看图写话·by + doing 表示方式
questions.analysis: 图中三名同学围坐一起小组学习，用“learn... by doing sth.”结构，可写“They learn English by working with a group.”。

questions.stem: 80. 看图写句（图：笔记本电脑与飞出的信件/笔友；提示词：improve, pal）
reference_answer: I improve my writing by writing to my pen pal.
He improves his English by writing e-mails to his pen pal.
I can improve my English by writing to my pen pal.
questions.answer_display: I improve my writing by writing to my pen pal.
questions.tag: 看图写话·动词 improve 与 pen pal
questions.analysis: 图中电脑旁有信件，提示词为 improve 和 pal（pen pal 笔友），可写“I improve my writing by writing to my pen pal.”。

questions.stem: You will __81__ (quick) be able to tell who is polite and who is not.
questions.tag: 词性转换（形容词变副词）
questions.analysis: 此处修饰动词短语 be able to，需要用形容词 quick 的副词形式 quickly。

questions.stem: Those who chew food with their __82__ (mouth) closed are polite.
questions.analysis: 前面有形容词性物主代词 their（他们的），对应的可数名词 mouth 要用复数形式 mouths。

questions.stem: They may talk l__83__ at the corner.
reference_answer: loudly
loud
oudly
oud
questions.tag: 首字母填空（副词修饰动词）
questions.analysis: 前文提到有礼貌的朋友轻声说话（talk quietly），对比之下不太礼貌的人会在角落里“大声说话”，修饰动词 talk 且首字母为 l，填 loudly。

questions.stem: Those who are not polite are usually getting __84__ trouble at lunch time with the teachers who are watching.
questions.analysis: get into trouble 是固定搭配，意为“陷入麻烦、惹麻烦”，所以填介词 into。

questions.stem: The __85__ (good) way to do this is to make eye contact with the person you are meeting.
questions.analysis: 空前有定冠词 The，表示“做这件事最好的方法”，用 good 的最高级 best。

questions.stem: Stick out your hand to s__86__ hands.
reference_answer: shake
hake
questions.analysis: 伸出手（Stick out your hand）是为了“握手”，shake hands 为固定搭配，to 后接动词原形 shake。

questions.stem: He or she will be __87__ (please) with how polite you are.
questions.analysis: be pleased with... 为固定短语，意为“对……感到满意/高兴”，所以填 pleased。

questions.stem: __88__ (be) polite tells others you respect them.
questions.analysis: 谓语动词是 tells，此处需要动名词短语作主语，且位于句首首字母必须大写，填 Being。

questions.stem: It also tells others that you know __89__ to act properly.
questions.analysis: know how to do sth. 表示“知道如何做某事”，结合副词 properly（得体地）可知填 how。

questions.stem: You will feel good about __90__ (you) when you are nice and polite to others.
reference_answer: yourself
yourselves
questions.analysis: 当主语和宾语指同一个人时用反身代词，“对自己感觉良好”用 feel good about yourself（复数语境亦可接受 yourselves）。

questions.stem:
《21世纪英文报》开设了 School Time 专栏面向中学生征稿，介绍自己校园的一角。假设你是李华。下图是你们学校 Star School 的平面示意图（入口 Entrance 与 School Gate 在西侧，校内有 Teaching building ①/②、Art Room、Music Room、Library、Laboratory building 实验楼、Dining hall、Playground、Gym）。转眼间，你已在这个校园里度过了两年多的时光。请结合你平时在校的学习和活动，写一篇稿件，介绍一个你最喜爱的校内场所。
要求：1. 介绍这个场所的方位；2. 你最喜欢这个场所的原因；3. 在这个场所的活动和回忆。
注意事项：1. 内容须自拟，语句通顺、意思连贯、符合题意；2. 词数在80词以上；3. 文中不得使用真实的个人姓名或学校名称。
开头已给出：I'm Li Hua. I have been studying in Star School for more than two years. ____
reference_answer: 要点1：明确写出最喜欢的校园场所名称（如 Library / Playground / Lab 等），并依据平面图准确描述其方位（如 across from / next to / between... and... / on the right of...）。
要点2：说明最喜欢该场所的原因（如安静舒适、藏书丰富、老师同学友好、设施齐全等）。
要点3：具体叙述在该场所常进行的日常活动及一段难忘的校园回忆（注意两年多的时间跨度，适当使用过去时与现在完成时）。
语言与格式：承接开头自然展开，词数80词以上，句式丰富、连贯无明显语法错误，不出现真实人名校名。
questions.answer_display: 要点提纲：选定场所并按平面图写清方位 → 说明喜爱原因 → 结合活动与具体回忆展开（80词以上）
questions.tag: 书面表达·校园场所介绍
questions.analysis: 写作时紧扣三个要点：先结合平面图用方位介词（如 next to、across from、behind）介绍所选地点位置；再说明喜欢原因；最后用一两件具体的学习或活动回忆丰富内容，注意衔接开头句并控制词数在80词以上。
